{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate
converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(loyal_df)
conversion_rate = converted_loyal / total_loyal

# Print results
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {total_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {converted_loyal}")
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate:.4f}")"}
